The issuer exhibits strong operating profitability with an operating margin of 20% on $1.82B of revenue, but carries a highly leveraged and illiquid balance sheet, as evidenced by total liabilities of $7.24B (Debt-to-Equity of over 2.5x) and a weak current ratio of 0.55 ($475M current assets vs $857M current liabilities). The significant gap between operating income ($371M) and net income ($67M) suggests heavy interest expenses or non-operating losses, indicating high debt-servicing costs. These substantial refinancing and liquidity risks, tempered by solid operating cash generation potential, are characteristic of a non-investment grade, speculative-grade profile.

DECISION: BB-
